purpose.intro: **What.** Standardised list endpoint contract — pagination, sort, multi-field ordering, search flag, scoped count, plus the React hook that drives URL-backed list state. **How.** One Zod factory composes the standard query params; one envelope helper shapes the `{ rows, total }` response; one hook (`useListQueryState`) syncs filters/page/sort to URL search params. **Why.** Every list endpoint has the same plumbing. Centralising it eliminates drift, keeps the count query in sync with the list query (preventing leaks), and gives the frontend a single source of truth for list state.

reference.statement: Building a list endpoint or a list page? Start in `consumer/` (`./consumer/`).
Changing the lib itself? Start in `contributor/` (`./contributor/`).
